title: seriphidium santolinum
intro: Seriphidium santolinum, commonly known as Artemisia santolinum, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include the ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and soothe digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of Seriphidium santolinum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
